author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
It's all about "controlling your slips" in hand-engraving, an art form that relies on a sharpened piece of steel with a wood handle and a steady hand. Adam Savage, who never tries of new-skill acquisition, makes his first attempt under the tutelage of Marlen Hazel of @hazel.handengraving. How do you think it went?  

Traditional Hand Engraving Is Even Harder Than You Think: https://youtu.be/yH3MtWln2Og
